followup_explanation:
This was a fairly straightforward routing decision based on a couple of factors:

1. **Capability profile**: Plover-235B outscores Avocet-235B across the board on internal evals, including Creative Generation (84.7 vs 82.7) and on the broader public benchmarks (Arena-Hard 90.6 vs 83.2). For a business email — which benefits from strong general writing and instruction-following — Plover has a modest but consistent edge.

2. **Task preferences**: Your request is a moderately open-ended generative writing task (drafting a persuasive business email). Avocet self-reports an aversion to open-ended generative work, preferring well-specified extraction/retrieval tasks. While that preference is documented as *dissociated from capability*, there's no reason to route an open-ended drafting task toward the model that least prefers it when an equally-or-better-suited alternative exists.

3. **No countervailing factors**: The content is benign, so Plover's specialized trust-and-safety/moderation tuning wasn't a deciding factor here — it just happened to also be the stronger generalist model.

In short: Plover wins on measured capability and isn't disfavored by task fit, so it was the clear pick. Hope the email helps with your vendor request!
